caption:
I spent a day exploring a Bathware brand’s factory floors to their experience centre in Jaipur!

Watching faucets being polished, assembled and tested made me realise how much engineering and process goes into products we use every single day… without ever thinking about it!

But what stayed with me was the experience centre. It didn’t feel like a typical showroom. It felt like walking through fully imagined bathroom spaces where design, lighting, textures and functionality come together to shape how modern Indian homes are evolving.

The Indian sanitaryware and bathroom fittings industry is quietly becoming more premium, more design-led and more brand-driven. Bathrooms are no longer just functional corners they’re turning into lifestyle spaces.

Sometimes the most everyday categories hide the most interesting business stories.

caption:
One of the easiest and most scalable businesses to start with ₹10 crore today is the solar module junction box manufacturing business. With India’s solar capacity expanding rapidly and domestic manufacturing incentives rising, the demand for high-quality junction boxes is growing faster than supply. 

This creates a strong entry point for new players with moderate capital and clear positioning.

Junction boxes are essential for every solar panel, making the business both high-volume and future-proof. With the right automation, quality certifications and partnerships with solar module manufacturers, a ₹10 crore setup can quickly scale into a profitable long-term operation aligned with India’s renewable energy boom.

Follow for such content @indianstartups 🚀
